videos.caption: “People are quick to look at Cristiano Ronaldo now and only see his age, but they forget how long he has been carrying the responsibility of representing Portugal. He was doing this before many of the current players were even part of the national team. He came into the squad as a teenager, faced pressure, criticism and disappointment, and kept coming back year after year. He scored important goals, played through difficult moments, broke records and helped Portugal win trophies. Now that he is older, that history should not suddenly disappear. Respecting Ronaldo does not mean younger players cannot have their moment. It means remembering who helped build the standard they are benefiting from today. You cannot celebrate Portugal’s success while acting like the man who gave more than two decades to the national team no longer matters. Ronaldo has been fighting for this badge since the beginning. Before the trophies, before the records and before Portugal became a team people expected to win, he was already there. Age can change a player’s role, but it cannot erase his legacy.” “You can replace Ronaldo in the starting eleven one day, but you cannot replace what he has done for Portugal.” #Goat #portugal #cristiano #ronaldo #purelove #greatestofalltime #portugalnationalteam #premierleague #laliga #championsleague
